title: Purely inseparable comparison of canonical field-extension exchange
statement: Let K,L,P,M be fields with compatible algebra structures K to L to M and K to P to M (the two composites K to M agree). Assume P/K and M/L purely inseparable. Let g:T to S be any morphism of K-schemes and E any bounded below derived abelian etale complex on T. Let T_P,S_P,g_P be their chosen scalar extensions to P, and E_P the exact inverse image of E. Then the canonical exchange for L/K at g,E is invertible if and only if the canonical exchange for M/P at g_P,E_P is invertible. No qcqs or torsion condition is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0F1C, lemma-base-change-field-extension; Tag 0E47 for horizontal exchange pasting

proof.text: Construct the actual map c_W from the iterated pullback (W_P)_M to W_L by pullback.lift on its projections. The scalar tower equations give b followed by a = c followed by r; pullback hom-ext proves naturality in W. Pullback pasting and cancellation show c_W is the base change of Spec M to Spec L. Pure inseparability gives universal homeomorphisms for Spec P to Spec K and Spec M to Spec L, hence also for a_W and c_W by base-change stability.

Use isEquivalence_upperStar for these universal homeomorphisms. The private plusEquivalence helper constructs the D+ quasi-inverse by applying mapDerivedCategoryPlus to a chosen quasi-inverse; mapDerivedCategoryPlusNatIso, the identity iso and the composition iso give its unit and counit explicitly. Consequently the specified D+ inverse images are equivalences and reflect isomorphisms.

For either purely inseparable square the private universalExchange helper identifies derivedBaseChangeMapPlus with the right mate of pullbackSquareComparison. This is proved by derivedBaseChangeMapPlus_ext, using Adjunction.derivedPlus_mateEquiv_app_fac and pullbackSquareComparison_hom_app_factorsh on every bounded-below homotopy complex. The two derivedPlus adjunctions and the mate-isomorphism theorem now give invertibility of this exact canonical exchange.

Apply the upstream horizontal pasting equation to squares (a,b) and (r,c). Their outer horizontal maps agree by the projection equations, so exchange_congr identifies the invertibility propositions for their outer exchanges. Expand the two pasting expressions at E and cancel the composition isomorphisms, the pullback of Ex_a, and Ex_c. This gives IsIso(Ex_b at a_T^* E) iff IsIso(c_S^*(Ex_r at E)). Reflection of isomorphisms by the equivalence c_S^* gives the asserted equivalence. The private exchange_diamond helper carries out this cancellation in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem isIso_fieldExtension_iff_of_purelyInseparable
    (K L P M : Type u) [Field K] [Field L] [Field P] [Field M]
    [Algebra K L] [Algebra K P] [Algebra L M] [Algebra P M] [Algebra K M]
    [IsScalarTower K L M] [IsScalarTower K P M]
    [IsPurelyInseparable K P] [IsPurelyInseparable L M]
    (T S : Over (Spec (.of K))) (g : T ⟶ S)
    (E : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf T.left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) :
    let r := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))
    let a := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K P))
    let b := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P M))
    let TP := (Over.pullback a).obj T
    let SP := (Over.pullback a).obj S
    let gP := (Over.pullback a).map g
    let EP := (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (pullback.fst T.hom a)).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj E
    IsIso ((derivedBaseChangeMapPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (⟨by simp [Over.pullback_map_left]⟩ : CommSq (pullback.fst T.hom r)
        ((Over.pullback r).map g).left g.left (pullback.fst S.hom r))).app E) ↔
    IsIso ((derivedBaseChangeMapPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (⟨by dsimp only [TP, SP]; simp only [Over.pullback_map_left, pullback.lift_fst]⟩ :
        CommSq (pullback.fst TP.hom b)
        ((Over.pullback b).map gP).left gP.left (pullback.fst SP.hom b))).app EP)
